item.title: Coast Guard is pursuing another tanker helping Venezuela skirt sanctions, US official says
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard on Sunday was pursuing another sanctioned oil tanker in the Caribbean Sea as the Trump administration appeared to be intensifying its targeting of such vessels connected to the Venezuelan government.

item.title: Multiple gunmen open fire at a South African pub, killing 9 and wounding 10
item.description: Nine people have died and at least 10 others were wounded after a group of gunmen carried out a shooting at a South African pub during the early hours of Sunday, authorities said.

item.title: These influencers are teaching Christianity online — and young people are listening
item.description: From myriad backgrounds, these influencers talk candidly to their listeners about everything from anxieties and doubts to dating and culture, delving into the Bible’s complexities. Those of faith say Christian influencers are galvanizing young people looking for meaning in a culture that lacks it at a time when years of declining church attendance has slowed.

item.title: ‘Avatar: Fire and Ash’ launches with $88M domestically, $345M worldwide
item.description: Sixteen years into the “Avatar” saga, Pandora is still abundant in box-office riches. “Fire and Ash,” the third film in Cameron’s science-fiction franchise, launched with $88 million domestically and $257 million internationally.

item.title: At least 16 files have disappeared from the DOJ webpage for documents related to Jeffrey Epstein
item.description: At least 16 files disappeared from the Justice Department’s public webpage for documents related to Jeffrey Epstein — including a photograph showing President Donald Trump — less than a day after they were posted, with no explanation from the government and no notice to the public.

item.title: Turning Point showcases the discord that Republicans like Vance will need to navigate in the future
item.description: The next presidential election is three years away, but Turning Point USA already knows it wants Vice President JD Vance as the Republican nominee.

item.title: With Christmas coming soon, be ready to see some heavy traffic
item.description: Traveling during the Christmas season is rough. If you travel by air, there might be delay. If you travel by road, you might get stuck in traffic. Make sure to prepare so that you can get to that destination safely.

item.title: Local Christmas tree lot honors legacy of dead family member
item.description: One family run business remembers dead relative who made the business and community smile.

item.title: Élysée Palace silver steward arrested for stealing thousands of euros’ worth of silverware
item.description: The Élysée Palace’s head steward reported the disappearance, with the estimated loss ranging between 15,000 and 40,000 euros (($17,500-$47,000).

item.title: Oak Island man arrested and charged with murder
item.description: According to warrants on e-courts, 31-year-old Joshua Cully Crook killed Gregory Seth Condrey sometime on Saturday.
